teacherNotes.title: 5-Step Vocab Progression
teacherNotes.content: 1. Recognition -> 2. Pronunciation -> 3. Classification -> 4. Controlled Production -> 5. Personalised Use

teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: profile, identity, information, personal, student, first name, surname, country, city, language, age, phone, email, about me

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
profile, identity, information, personal, student, first name, surname, country, city, language, age, phone, email, about me
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Let me introduce myself (beginning profile presentation)
• My name is... and I am from... (stating name and origin)
• I am... years old (stating age)
• I can speak... (stating languages)
• My contact details are... (sharing contact details)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Aim
teacherNotes.content: Consolidation of sentence rhythm, pause units between personal details, clear presentation intonation.

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
Consolidation of sentence rhythm, pause units between personal details, clear presentation intonation.

teacherNotes.title: Function-First Grammar Rule
teacherNotes.content: Recycling capstone: combining verb 'be', 'have', 'can', possessive adjectives, and numbers in a coherent personal profile.

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Recycling capstone: combining verb 'be', 'have', 'can', possessive adjectives, and numbers in a coherent personal profile.
Examples:

• My name is Alex.
• I am 24 years old.
• I am from Canada.
• I can speak English and French.
• My email is alex@web.ca.
Reading Dialogue & Script:

Script using target language:
Person A: Let me introduce myself
Person B: My name is... and I am from...
Listening Comprehension Prompt: Listen to the prompt and confirm understanding.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: Pair roleplay, information gap, and personalized speaking task.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice with your partner: I can present a complete personal profile introducing my name, age, country, languages, contact details, and basic info.
Short Writing Task (~10%): Write 3-4 sentences in your notebook applying target chunks.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60 min Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up Profile Matching; 10-20m Model Profile Reading; 20-35m Profile Card Drafting; 35-55m Student Oral Profile Presentations & Peer Q&A; 55-60m Module 1 Graduation Cool-down.

• 90 min Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-25m Vocabulary & Grammar Review; 25-45m Guided Profile Writing; 45-70m Group Speed-Networking Interviews; 70-85m Peer Assessment; 85-90m Module Wrap-up.

• 120 min Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-35m Module 1 Skills Station Review; 35-65m Digital Profile Poster Creation; 65-100m Class Identity Exhibition & Oral Interviews; 100-115m Reflection & Portfolio Entry; 115-120m Celebration.
